name: Hyphenated wordmark assembles under a small subhead
looks: A small all-caps subhead sits above, then the product's hyphen-joined name drops in piece by piece until it is whole, the hyphens themselves in the accent colour.
build: wordmark-assemble's letter-drop mechanic applied per name-segment instead of per letter (three or four chunks separated by hyphens), each chunk's delay growing outward from the centre segment; the hyphens pop in last, in the accent colour.
sound: A tick per chunk landing, a slightly sharper tick on each hyphen.
prompt: Assemble a hyphen-joined product name piece by piece from the centre outward, with a small technical subhead already in place above it and the hyphens themselves picked out in the brand's accent colour as the last detail to land.
